summary: Useful variants reduce duplication, surface freshness and tailor the map to the reader's task.

items.text: Generate dependency and path inventories, then keep only architectural intent and exceptions hand-authored.
Attach per-feature owners, lifecycle and review dates as local companions while the root map remains an index.
Run a drift check that compares declared components and dependencies with the build graph and source tree.
Organize the map by cohesive feature folders so a feature entry resolves to a bounded working set.
